note.question: What determines capacity provisioning for an online service supported by advertising?
note.overview: In this paper, we consider the problem of capacity provisioning for an online service supported by advertising. The paper analyzes the strategic interaction between the service provider and the user base in this setting, modeling positive network effects, as well as congestion sensitivity in the user base. We focus specifically on the influence of positive network effects, as well as the impact of noncooperative behavior in the user base on the firm’s capacity provisioning decision and its profit.
